newsitem.title: USA: NCR says Penney installs system.
newsitem.headline: NCR says Penney installs system.

text.p: AT&T Corp's computer unit, NCR Corp, said Tuesday that retailer J.C. Penney Co Inc installed $11 million in NCR systems for its catalog operations.
Installation began in June and last month the systems became an integrated part of J.C. Penney's "lights out" data center designed to operate with minimal staffing, NCR said in a statement.
The systems will help Penney in its long-term strategy away from mass marketing to a more targeted marketing approach, NCR said.

"The combination of NCR's massively parallel WorldMark hardware architecture and its Teradata database enables us to use business data that we collect every day to better serve and expand our customer base," said Penney's Dave Evans, senior vice president of information systems.

AT&T has said it expects to spin off its NCR unit by year-end as part of its "trivestiture" announced earlier this year. It previously spun off another unit, Lucent Technologies Inc. Retailing is a key NCR market.
